name: Vysions
description:
About This Game



Vysions is a first-person puzzle game that explores a series of dreams manifested as 3D worlds.

Explore unique realms with cryptic machines, enigmatic symbols and riddles to unfold.

"We were alone in a distant void where time had no substance. Then a spark in the mind emerged. Light, thought, and the indecipherable struggles of the other world reaching out as Vysions."
short_desc: Welcome to Vysions, a world made of dreams, where puzzles are truth and you must bring meaning to their madness.
